manifest.name: dsh-focus-mode
manifest.description: An external focus-mode preset with persistent command tools and hybrid execution.

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: external-preset-focus-mode
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: focus-mode
        name: Focus mode
        description: Persistent command sessions with direct tools and program execution.
        order: 5
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: persistent-shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              terminals: true
            config:
              - id: terminals
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal'
              - id: terminal-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 300000
              - id: terminal-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  shellDialect: pwsh
                  timeoutMs: 300000
              - id: focus-commands
                name: dsh-focus-mode/exec
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-cordis
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
          - id: focus-hybrid
            name: dsh-focus-mode/hybrid

readme.text:
English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

An external [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) preset with persistent shell sessions, direct tool calls, and TypeScript program execution. No dsh source or frontend patches are required.

Compatibility: dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.3`, validated against upstream commit `22ddee3792402c3e70ec5f86a63c3e3e895a2f60`. Node.js `>=24.9` is required. This repository extracts the 0.1.2 plugin implementation; its runtime sources and bundle declaration match that implementation.

Downloadable packages are published on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Stautaffly/dsh-focus-mode/releases). Use the official dsh CLI to install the archive directly; users do not need to clone the repository, prepare a host checkout, or install TypeScript. This plugin has not been published to npm.

Use the CLI belonging to your target DSH application and an initialized Web profile. For a profile named `web`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Stautaffly/dsh-focus-mode/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-focus-mode-0.2.0.tgz
```

Replace `web` with your actual profile name, such as `web-vanilla`; this command changes only the selected profile. Restart that DSH application after installation, refresh the browser, and choose **Focus mode** in a new session. Installation adds a preset without changing your current default.

To check that the bundle was discovered, run:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The output should contain `external-preset-focus-mode`. The compatibility requirements at the top of this README still apply; this release does not upgrade the host.

Choose a compatible version from [Releases](https://github.com/Stautaffly/dsh-focus-mode/releases), then run the same `dsh plugin --profile ... add <release-archive-url>` command with that version's download URL and restart the application. The example above pins `0.1.2`; repeating it reinstalls that version rather than selecting a future release automatically.

Finish sessions using the preset, then remove the bundle from the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-focus-mode
```

Restart the application and refresh the browser after removal. Existing sessions retain their recorded preset selection; choose another preset before continuing them without this plugin.

For local builds and installation from a directory or archive, see [development](#development).

- `exec_command({cmd, session_id?, cwd?, run_in_background?, new_session?})` runs a command in an Agent-owned persistent shell. Working directory and environment survive successive calls: omitting `session_id` reuses this Agent's most recently used live shell, so the caller does not have to carry an id forward. Pass `new_session:true` to start another shell; `cwd` starts one for that directory and applies only at creation. A background command that omits `session_id` starts its own shell, because a background job owns the whole shell.
- `write_stdin({session_id, chars?, run_in_background?, close?})` reads new output or sends input. A newline submits input; a standalone Ctrl-C interrupts. `close:true` closes the shell and releases its slot.
- `focus_sessions({})` lists the shells this Agent owns with their `session_id`, running or exited state, whether a call or background job is using each one, and which shell an omitted `session_id` reuses.
- Every result is a structured value: `session_id`, `status`, `created`, `send`, `wait`, `text`, and `incomplete`, plus `exit_code`, `signal`, or `job_id` when they apply. Direct calls render the same `[session …]` header as before; `run_code`

The preset retains agent instructions, time context, compaction, skills, web tools, deliverables, plugin inspection/management, and workflows. Additional visible tools from Agent Teams, session search, worktrees, or terminal plugins are inherited automatically. Direct schemas plus the program SDK increase prompt size; PTC can keep intermediate results out of the conversation history.

The plugin defaults to four persistent shell sessions per Agent and two background jobs per Agent. Session count is configurable from 1 to 64. `reuseMostRecentSession` keeps calls that omit `session_id` on one shell; turn it off to require an explicit `session_id` or `new_session` on every call. The upstream jobs registry has a separate concurrent-job limit. The [16-session/16-job example](examples/limits-16.patch.yml) overrides both:

```sh
dsh --profile focus-sandbox --patch ./examples/limits-16.patch.yml --dump-config
dsh --profile focus-sandbox --patch ./examples/limits-16.patch.yml
```

`--patch` applies to that launch. For a permanent override, merge the example's two rows into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, preserving other settings and existing fields on the `jobs` row.

In this dsh version, a profile patch replaces a matched row's **whole config**. The command tools are nested in a preset declaration, so the example restates `external-preset-focus-mode` and changes `persistent-shell → focus-commands → config.maxSessionsPerAgent`. A top-level `preset: focus-mode` / `id: focus-commands` patch is not supported. Keep a copied preset declaration aligned with future bundle upgrades.

| Command-tool option | Default | Allowed range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backendType` | `shell` | Registered terminal backend |
| `maxSessionsPerAgent` | 4 | 1–64 |
| `maxBackgroundJobsPerAgent` | 2 | 1–64 |
| `reuseMostRecentSession` | `true` | boolean |
| `bindChangeRequests` | `true` | boolean |
| `maxResultBytes` | 262144 | 256–16777216 bytes |
| `yieldMs` | 1000 | 0–60000 ms |
| `pollMs` | 50 | 1–10000 ms |
| `readLines` | 10000 | 1–100000 |

Result byte limits include metadata. Truncation retains the tail and reports possible loss; increase the read/retention settings and rerun a command when omitted output is required. Terminal send timeouts and scrollback retention belong to the `terminal-bash` / `terminal-pwsh` configuration.

Only plugin developers need a host source checkout. The `0.2.1-rc.3` native/PTC executor packages used by this baseline are not published on npm. Development builds and integration tests therefore use a prepared checkout; they do not substitute the incompatible published alpha versions. `.npmrc` disables automatic peer installation, and the lockfile pins development tools and ordinary dependencies.

Prepare a separate host checkout at the compatibility commit:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git ../deepseek-harness
git -C ../deepseek-harness checkout 22ddee3792402c3e70ec5f86a63c3e3e895a2f60

```

Then, from this plugin repository:

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
DSH_SOURCE="$PWD/../deepseek-harness" npm run link:host
npm run typecheck
npm run build
DSH_SOURCE="$PWD/../deepseek-harness" npm test
mkdir -p dist
npm run pack:release
```

Install the resulting archive into a development profile with the official CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile focus-sandbox add ./dist/dsh-focus-mode-0.1.2.tgz
```

readme.text: The link script creates links only inside this repository's ignored `node_modules`; it does not install the plugin into the host or edit host files. Re-run it after `npm ci`. Keep development profiles separate from production profiles.

readme.text: `DSH_SOURCE` is explicit; there are no personal paths or vendored host sources. The test configuration reads the host's source aliases and decorator transform, and generates a lazy fixture import map. The 24 existing tests cover real Loader/PTY/jobs behavior, dynamic tool registration and withdrawal, authorization, cancellation/cleanup, pagination, direct/PTC ordering and logs, Web/addon composition, and isolated directory/archive installation and removal. They use no model keys or real model requests.

readme.text: Runtime code belongs in `src/`; host integration fixtures and expected output belong in `tests/`. See [plugin organization](docs/plugin-organization.md) for a layout that can grow to multiple plugins.

- Compatibility is pinned to one pre-stable host baseline; upgrades require revalidation.
- Shell sessions live in memory and do not survive a process restart. Exited sessions count toward the quota until closed. Agent or plugin teardown closes owned terminals.
- The scrollback interface lacks a monotonic byte cursor. Identical output replacing an entire retained window cannot always be distinguished; already discarded bytes cannot be recovered.
- The profile must provide the upstream Web host capabilities and a PTC runtime. This bundle does not launch a server or configure a model/network provider.
- Full browser UI, real providers, and Windows/macOS behavior were not covered by the Linux keyless suite. The preset name and description do not use the host's built-in preset translation table.
